spec.independence: Fresh first/replay worker processes reconstruct the frozen candidate, original baseline, analytic target, supplied probes, controller trajectory, retimed plan and exact owner map. Never call learning search, fit_seed, build, execute_fixture, measure_fixture or reuse saved training motion metrics as evaluation results. Reuse existing compiler/controller, renderer, pure crop/containment and stroke_loss only.
spec.targets: Read contract spec-v1 endpoint/ray and analytic target parameters. Independently evaluate expanded cubic Hermite basis plus signed sine-squared vertical bulge and attach frozen old-six curves by endpoint translation. No candidate controls or grammar feed the target generator. Keep all five learning held-out fixture definitions and scales unchanged.
spec.baseline: Before extension proofs in each first/replay worker, verify pinned lineage and current motion admission; rerender/recompute original independent synthetic baseline through foundation_motion.revalidate_baseline with the shared seed budget. No old hash edits or model fitting.
spec.subdivision: Independently De Casteljau split every cubic of every used primitive, including lower/upper returns, in an isolated v2 execution copy. Do not use the prior stem-only subdivision helper or change the saved fitted model. Check equivalence and preserve occurrence ownership.
spec.regions: Keep the predeclared learning physical family-local loss and blank boxes, reconstructing their origins independently from target endpoints. Reject clipped contact footprints and out-of-frame regions. Report before/after and blank occupancy per family, fixture and seed; full-image averages cannot conceal an absent family.

controls.wrong-port: Move each return entry handle horizontally by 0.10 x-height; require foundation model validation rejection before admission.
controls.wrong-direction: Reverse each return entry handle through its fixed endpoint; require model rejection.
controls.detached-geometry: Offset the supplied underturn return attachment by 0.10 x-height; require continuous-port rejection. Also shift a realized trace point by 0.5mm; independent corridor/trajectory audit must reject.
controls.hidden-lift: Set a middle contact trace sample to air without changing the recomputed plan; exact owner/contact audit must reject, regardless of global image difference.
controls.painted-air-connector: Use a declared lifted lower-return pair at offsets [0,0] and [1.2,0]. Flip air samples to contact with pressure0.5; recomputed owner/contact audit must reject. The unmodified guard must pass.
controls.extra-contributor: Append an exactly overlapping trace contributor with an undeclared occurrence ID; exact owner/order/trace audit must reject even if pixels are identical.
controls.erased-counter: Rerun the independent analytic tool oracle's fixed terminal/connector/circle fixtures with its predeclared blank/counter regions. Fill the radius0.45 counter; local ink fraction >0.01 must detect it. This is a guard test, not learned closed-counter or letter acceptance.

spec.global_control_scope: Preserve the original 0.1 global minimum and historical hidden-connector/extra-terminal failures verbatim. Global scores remain diagnostic for localized topology changes: predeclared exact contact/owner/port rejection and independent local blank/counter probes are the required replacement, because aggregate disagreement cannot detect an exactly overlapping extra owner. Never relabel a below-0.1 global score as passing or lower its threshold.
spec.presentation: Save target/initial/candidate/sampled/actual full-frame 900-DPI sheets and local-control sheet; charge all renders, setup, control, refinement and presentation work to the shared first-plus-replay per-seed allowance. No image retouching or new renderer.
spec.readiness: Explicit S1-foundation-primitives-v1 reader requires the consumer to freeze an expected report SHA, checks current code/spec/source/artifact identities, matching first/replay content and recomputed complete decision. Only matched original-six plus lower/upper returns may feed bounded fixed-tool shared-gesture learning. No dynamic-action, letters, real-source, fatigue or historical approval.
